public_rationale: The evidence cuts against an absolute claim of no flexibility: BERT research reported accurate separation of literal and idiomatic uses. Other research found substantial difficulty interpreting metaphors with GPT-3. Neither test directly establishes the human-like switching ability described here. These earlier results are context, not outcome evidence for the target snapshot. A firm verdict would depend on treating classification success or metaphor errors as a substitute for the claimed ability.
limitations: The available tests use different tasks and model configurations.
The claim supplies no numerical standard for the human degree of flexibility.
